content: Baseline. For the baseline systems, the training data includes KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts. For comparison purpose, we build two baseline systems for each direction: one is use the traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT), the other one is the NMT system. Although our training set is small but we find that the NMT systems (2) are still more effective than the phrase-based SMT models (1) in both translation directions.
